## Purpose

Immediately stop an active omission-policy identity from authorizing omission.

## When a playbook uses it

A local operator responding to a critical miss or unexplained version drift. This command is unavailable to session and playbook callers.

## How it works internally

The handler rechecks local authority and atomically sets the first revocation time and reason. A repeated or unknown ID returns `revoked: false`. See [`test_selection_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/test_selection_commands.py) and [`service.py`](../../../src/test_selection/service.py).

## Side effects and persistence

Updates only the promotion’s revocation fields and emits `test_selection.revoked.v1` only when a revocation occurs. Past proposals and observations remain immutable.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

`out_of_scope` requires a local operator. `revoked: false` is a safe no-op, not a new revocation event. Inspect `test_selection_policy_show` to confirm that no active promotion remains.

## Example step

Command-step payload (promotion/revocation examples require a local operator context):

```json
{"command": "test_selection_revoke", "args": {"promotion_id": "tsprom-example", "reason": "critical regression missed"}}
```
